name: perisclaw
description: Use your own WhatsApp from Codex through Perisclaw, your AI executive assistant on WhatsApp: catch up, search chats and send replies.

interface.shortDescription: Use your own WhatsApp from Codex: catch up, search chats, send replies.
interface.longDescription: Perisclaw connects the WhatsApp number you already use to Codex, ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools. Ask what needs your reply, find a message or address someone sent, summarise a busy group, and review and send replies. Sign in with OAuth, choose read-only or read and write, and revoke access anytime.
defaultPrompt: What needs my reply on WhatsApp?
Find the office address Periskope Enterprise sent me.
Reply to Bharat that Friday works.
